text.tspan: Share of urban vs. rural population using at least basic sanitation 2024
Share of urban versus rural population using at least basic sanitation facilities, that is improved sanitation
facilities, such as toilets or latrines, not shared with other households.

tspan.tspan: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (2025)
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
